Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of HD.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $1.88 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 113 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2020.
Operating income reached $10.7 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 918 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
